description: This is a Python script named 'lldbclient.py' used for debugging Android applications via LLDB. It includes functions for locating LLDB binaries, setting up debugging sessions, managing device connections, and generating debugging scripts, especially tailored for Android's build environment and device setup.

methods.name: read_toolchain_config(root)
methods.description: Determines the current Clang version by executing a script within the build environment.

methods.name: get_lldb_path(toolchain_path)
methods.description: Locates the LLDB executable within a specified toolchain directory.

methods.name: get_lldb_server_path(root, clang_base, clang_version, arch)
methods.description: Constructs the path to the LLDB server binary on the device based on architecture.

methods.name: get_tracer_pid(device, pid)
methods.description: Retrieves the tracer process ID for a given process to determine if tracing is active.

methods.name: parse_args()
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for attaching or running processes, ports, and debugging setup.

methods.name: verify_device(root, device)
methods.description: Checks if the connected device matches the expected target properties.

methods.name: get_remote_pid(device, process_name)
methods.description: Finds the remote process ID for a process by name on the device.

methods.name: make_temp_dir(prefix)
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory for linker or debugger operations.

methods.name: ensure_linker(device, sysroot, interp)
methods.description: Ensures that the device's linker binary is available locally, copying or pulling if necessary.

methods.name: handle_switches(args, sysroot)
methods.description: Determines which binary or process to attach to based on command-line options, preparing for debugging.

methods.name: generate_vscode_lldb_script(root, sysroot, binary_name, port, solib_search_path)
methods.description: Creates a JSON configuration for debugging with VSCode and LLDB.

methods.name: generate_lldb_script(root, sysroot, binary_name, port, solib_search_path)
methods.description: Generates LLDB commands for connecting to the remote debugging target.

methods.name: generate_setup_script(debugger_path, sysroot, linker_search_dir, binary_file, is64bit, port, debugger, connect_timeout=5)
methods.description: Produces a script or configuration commands to set up LLDB or vscode-lldb environment for debugging.

methods.name: do_main()
methods.description: Main execution function orchestrating argument parsing, device setup, debugging connection, and session management.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Entry point executing the main debugging setup process and cleanup.

ctags.name: generate_setup_script
ctags.pattern: /^def generate_setup_script(debugger_path, sysroot, linker_search_dir, binary_file, is64bit, port,/
ctags.signature: (debugger_path, sysroot, linker_search_dir, binary_file, is64bit, port, debugger, connect_timeout=5)
